title: Settings panel: backends, gocloak, model prefs, skills, all config
description: Implement settings panel (modal overlay, opened by gear icon): Remote backends section (add/remove: server URL, gocloak realm, connect/disconnect, WG status), Model settings (preference order, auto-cycling, capacity threshold, when-all-full, default filters, excluded terms, custom links), Skills section (install sources, toggle skills, pinned commits), Endpoint section (local/remote mode), Cache/history options. All persisted via server endpoints or local Keychain.
acceptance_criteria: Settings panel opens as modal overlay via gear icon
Remote backends: add/remove (server URL, gocloak realm), connect/disconnect, WG status shown
Model settings: preference order, auto-cycling, capacity threshold, when-all-full, filters, excluded terms, custom links all configurable
Skills: install sources, toggle skills, pinned commits all work
All settings persisted: server endpoints or local Keychain
Settings changes take effect immediately (no restart needed)
